verdict.rationale: Docs and README explicitly claim scanning beyond git (Docker images, object stores, filesystems, CI-adjacent chats/wikis/logs) and list S3-like object store sources, but the evidence pack lacks concrete CLI examples or verified probes for S3/Docker/CI-log scans specifically—only git scanning was directly probed. A community comment even notes the lack of a comparable Docker-image secret scanner from TruffleHog, undercutting the docs' claim for that specific source.
